strategy_roster.name: CCI Divergence
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so a new 5-bar low plus RSI(20)<30 proxies oversold price/CCI divergence; RSI crossing 50 proxies the zero-line exit. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Improved EMA & CDC Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,60) and ema(close,60) > ema(close,90) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,60) or ema(close,60) < ema(close,90) or macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented EMA60/EMA90 filter and standard MACD 12/26/9; EMA/MACD reversal approximates the unrepresentable ATR trailing stop and target.

strategy_roster.name: Rally Base Drop SND Pivots
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented Length=3 as a pivot proxy: cross above the prior 3-bar high and exit on loss of the prior 3-bar low; ATR stop and 6R target are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Intraday v2
strategy_roster.notes: Preserves outer 2.4-band entry and inner 1-band exit; period 20 is the standard fallback because the corpus omits the Bollinger period.

strategy_roster.name: N Candles Sequence
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and roc(close,2) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: Approximates three consecutive bullish closes with the current body and rising one- and two-bar ROC; a bearish close approximates sequence exhaustion, while pip exits are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: VR Overturn
strategy_roster.notes: The documented default first trade is Buy and has no market trigger; the true price guard represents that initial long, while PnL-dependent reversal, martingale sizing, and pip exits are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Exp T3 TRIX
strategy_roster.notes: Translates the default Twist mode with Fast Length=10: ROC crossing its smoothed baseline proxies a TRIX slope reversal because T3/TRIX are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Hans Indicator Cloud System Tm Plus
strategy_roster.notes: Uses Bollinger 20/2 as a channel proxy for a bullish breakout returning inside, with a middle-band exit; Hans colours, sessions, timed liquidation, and pip limits are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: One Price Stop-Loss / Take-Profit
strategy_roster.notes: This utility never opens trades and only manages protection on an existing position; the false price guard preserves that behavior without inventing ZenPrice.

strategy_roster.name: Up3x1 Investor Range Filter
strategy_roster.notes: Preserves the documented bullish range/body filters and uses the qualifying bearish candle as the reversal exit; Monday filtering and point-based risk levels are not representable.
